maturity_source.note: Per-table maturity badges only. The canonical CLIF repo's maturity.md tiers the project as a whole and does not label individual tables, so the website badge is the sole per-table beta/concept signal. Six tables carry a Concept badge while sitting under the website's 'Beta tables' heading; the badge is authoritative.

note: Columns, data types, permissible values, and foreign keys are parsed from the consortium's canonical CLIF 2.1 DDL. clifpy's schemas/2.1/*.yaml is the second canonical artifact and is cross-checked in the test suite, not merged.
